newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES EASE, CLOSE AT 19.625 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES EASE, CLOSE AT 19.625 PERCENT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates ended softer on Thursday at 19.625 percent, traders said.
Overnight rates traded in a narrow range between 19.50 and 19.625 percent compared with Wednesday's close of 19.75 percent.
Interbank overnight rates hovered between 19.50 and 20.00 percent amid abundant money supply and moderate activity since the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period on August 1.
